req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts a partial payload and leaves omitted fields unchanged. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP – sending only one field updates that field and preserves others; (2) negative NEG – sending an invalid/missing task_id returns 404; (3) boundary BVA – title at exactly 1 character (min_length boundary) and at 100 characters (max_length boundary); (4) DT – updating each individual field independently to confirm isolation; (5) STC – transitioning completed from false→true and true→false via partial update. All tests use pre-loaded rows (ids 1-20) and in-process TestClient.

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_title_preserves_other_fields
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
actions: Assert response body title equals 'Updated title only'
Assert response body description equals original value
Assert response body completed equals false
expected: description unchanged: 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_only_title_preserves_other_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put("/tasks/7", json={"title": "Updated title only"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 7
    assert body["title"] == "Updated title only"
    assert body["description"] == "Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith."
    assert body["completed"] == False

actions: PUT /tasks/13 with full payload {"title": "Buy organic groceries", "description": "From the farmers market", "completed": true}
Assert all three fields are updated

from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_all_fields_simultaneously():

    payload = {
        "title": "Buy organic groceries",
        "description": "From the farmers market",
        "completed": True
    }

    body = r.json()

    assert body["description"] == "From the farmers market"

actions: Assert response body contains id, title, description, completed, created_at
expected: Response body has keys: id, title, description, completed, created_at
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_response_contains_required_schema_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put("/tasks/3", json={"completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 3
    assert "title" in body
    assert "description" in body
    assert "completed" in body
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["title"] == "Submit expense report"
